parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/business/stock/Item.ts is in the business (domain) layer. Its domain behaviour, needsReorder(onHand), belongs there. However, the class also carries persistence mapping: it is decorated with TypeORM's @Entity() and its sku property is decorated with @Column(). These decorators make the domain entity declare its own ORM table and column mapping, which is the job of the persistence (infrastructure) layer. The typeorm import itself is an import-direction concern and is out of scope here. The problem is the ORM mapping metadata on the domain class, which is a persistence responsibility placed in a domain file.
